steps.en: OCMS receives unpaid parking charge transactions from the parking system
steps.id: OCMS menerima transaksi denda parkir belum bayar dari sistem parkir
steps.why_en: Which receiving point REPCCS really calls cannot be confirmed from the code.
steps.why_id: Titik terima mana yang benar-benar dipanggil REPCCS tidak bisa dipastikan dari code.

steps.en: The transaction is handled the moment it arrives
steps.why_en: Whether REPCCS really sends each transaction instantly cannot be seen from the code.
steps.why_id: Apakah REPCCS benar-benar mengirim tiap transaksi seketika tidak terlihat dari code.

steps.en: The transaction is checked and saved as a notice
steps.id: Transaksi dicek lalu disimpan sebagai notice
steps.why_en: Only the save is shown; the story gives no rules for checking, so this stays a partial match.
steps.why_id: Hanya penyimpanan yang terlihat; story tidak memberi aturan pengecekan, jadi tetap sebagian.

steps.en: The notice starts the automatic follow-up steps
steps.id: Notice masuk ke langkah tindak lanjut otomatis
steps.why_en: The Pre-Notice flow document is not available, so the match cannot be confirmed.
steps.why_id: Dokumen alur Pre-Notice tidak tersedia, jadi kesesuaian tidak bisa dipastikan.

steps.en: Unpaid charges are followed up by the automatic process
steps.id: Denda belum bayar ditindaklanjuti oleh proses otomatis
steps.why_en: Follow-up runs twice a day, not instantly, and went wrong for some notices after go-live.
steps.why_id: Tindak lanjut jalan dua kali sehari, bukan seketika, dan sempat salah untuk sebagian notice setelah go-live.
